planets.name: K2-91 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-91 with a 1.42-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-91 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-91. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
